name: Natural Biocon (India) Limited
summary: Natural Biocon India Ltd. focuses on supplying a range of agricultural commodities. The company provides various chemical and naturally derived extracts. Its extensive product range features substances such as nicotine, caffeine, tenin, morphine, codeine, strychnine, nuxvomicase, brucine, barley malt, maltose, malt sugar, and their respective derivatives. This enterprise was established on August 27, 1992, with its central operations based in Ahmedabad, India.
